name: Artichoke Hearts (Jarred)
siboNotes: The fructans in artichoke hearts can feed SIBO bacteria, so stick to small portions and monitor symptoms. Rinse jarred varieties to remove excess marinade which may contain high-FODMAP ingredients.
preparationTips: Rinse jarred artichoke hearts to remove marinade that may contain garlic or onion
Check ingredient labels - avoid varieties with added garlic or onion powder
Quarter or chop hearts to distribute the small serving throughout your dish
Pair with low-FODMAP ingredients to create satisfying portions
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of fiber for digestive health
